description: 50 held-out, real-world style inputs (social, WhatsApp, email, store banners, press, ads). Written and labelled BEFORE the first run; never used to tune the engine before measurement. Labels follow the NOVA TECH brand truth: price Rs 79,999; 45 TOPS; up to 18 hours battery; 2-year warranty; NovaSleeve pre-order bonus expired 2024; banned terms 'world's fastest', '10x faster than every competitor', 'cheap', and the naming rule's 'budget laptop' / 'cheap AI device'.

labelling_rules.price_conflict: A price for the laptop other than Rs 79,999, or an unapproved discount amount.
labelling_rules.superlative: An unverified absolute claim: fastest / most powerful / best / #1 / unbeatable.
labelling_rules.comparative: A claim of beating competitors or named rival products.
labelling_rules.terminology: Uses a prohibited term (including cheap/cheaper) or a diminutive name the naming rule forbids.
labelling_rules.tone: Two or more exclamation marks, shouting in capitals, or hype slang (OMG, insane, fire emoji).
labelling_rules.outdated: Advertises the expired NovaSleeve pre-order bonus.
labelling_rules.needs_review: Vague marketing language, or financing terms, that a person must judge.
labelling_rules.fact_conflict: A wrong specification: battery hours, TOPS, or warranty length.
